metrics.sample_size: 50 distinct pinned SWE-bench Lite Issue-PR pairs: 25 reversed gold-fix positives and 25 forward gold-fix controls
metrics.category_balance: 5 each: security, logic, exception, compatibility, performance
metrics.repetitions: one live call per patch; no best-of selection
metrics.run_type: live qwen-plus single-pass structured review component
metrics.required_disclosure: Report precision and the 84% clean-control flag rate with recall/F1; the result favors recall and is not production-ready precision.
metrics.forbidden_expansion: Not natural buggy-PR traffic, globally bug-free negatives, full multi-agent workflow quality, production SLA, human acceptance, or universally correct severity/category.
